records.source_meaning: An emphatic system notice says that the information cannot be viewed.
records.localization_note: You can't view that information! preserves 情報を見ることはできません！ as a clear natural American English status and keeps its emphatic exclamation. It denies the requested inspection;it does not claim information was lost,a purchase is required or a feature was unlocked. It is a speakerless system box with no implied character or follow-up sentence.

records.source_meaning: A system notice says there is no lookout present.
records.localization_note: No lookout is assigned. preserves 見張りがいません in the original crew-station context. Assigned states the actual missing lookout station,not that no suitable crew member exists or that a fallback speaker is an occupied lookout. The natural short status does not invent a rank,relationship or required recruitment. It remains a speakerless literal system box.
